summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, announcing the grant of 16,220,972 restricted share units (RSUs) to 438 employees under its 2026 Share Incentive Plan. The RSUs represent approximately 0.36% of total issued shares, with a purchase price of HK$0.01 per share. The closing price on the grant date was HK$4.92. Vesting schedules range from one to five years, subject to individual performance targets. This is an ordinary equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation event. No corporate action, such as an acquisition or restructuring, is involved.
